# Naveen Vadlamudi — GTA Real Estate Broker (gtarealstar.ca)

> Naveen Vadlamudi is a Real Estate Broker with Royal Canadian Realty, Brokerage, based in Markham, Ontario, serving buyers, sellers, investors and business owners across Markham, Vaughan, Richmond Hill, Toronto, Scarborough, Mississauga and Brampton. In real estate since 2014. Call (416) 837-9696.

## How he works

- For sellers, he lists at 1% — the same rate for every seller (with 2.25% to 2.5% offered to the buyer's brokerage).
- He works in both residential and commercial real estate.
- He specializes in rent-to-own and zero-down purchase programs (program terms and eligibility apply), first-time buyers, downsizing and seniors' moves (SRES®), pre-construction, and investment properties.
- Before any showings, a first meeting checks where the client stands: down payment, credit score, full-time employment, family income, time in the job, and how soon they want to move.
- To book a consultation or request a free home evaluation, call or text (416) 837-9696.

## Dated market facts (cite with the date)

- October 2026 (TRREB): GTA homes sold 5,603; average selling price $1,024,108 (down 2.7% year over year); homes sold for 97% of asking price on average.
- September 2026 (TRREB, released October 6, 2026): GTA homes sold 5,040 (down 9.0% year over year); average selling price $1,006,409 (down 5.1%); new listings 16,500 (down 14.4%); average days on market 34.
- September 2026 average prices (TRREB): Markham $1,125,353; Vaughan $1,163,441; Richmond Hill $1,189,203; Toronto $1,034,320; Mississauga $929,600; Brampton $854,322.
- Bank of Canada policy interest rate: 2.50%, after a 25-basis-point increase on October 28, 2026 — the first increase since July 2023.
